name: Rafael Castro
report:
No NBA stats and no projections in our data.

| Price in USD | Yahoo value | Yahoo average cost | Yahoo rank | ESPN value | ESPN average cost | ESPN rank | Our league 2025-26 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-27 | 0 | - | 680 | - | - | - | not drafted |

**Current**
- Walker Kessler is the Lakers starting center. Backup center is an open question, with Kevon Looney and Mamukelashvili ahead in line for those minutes. (fact, 2026-10-06; [10-06](https://youtu.be/sFelMKWcqyI?t=173), [10-06](https://youtu.be/sFelMKWcqyI?t=1441), [09-14](https://youtu.be/LM0cRCGoAUQ?t=2316), [08-04](https://youtu.be/_WjOjp6Qu8E?t=1701))
- The Lakers' backup centers are weak and the team depends on Kessler. A Kessler injury is the main way a backup big could get real minutes. (verdict, 2026-10-06; [07-13](https://youtu.be/Rqb5GdrSweY?t=778), [10-06](https://youtu.be/sFelMKWcqyI?t=173), [08-04](https://youtu.be/_WjOjp6Qu8E?t=1701))
- He went undrafted in the 2026 NBA draft and signed a two-way deal after the draft. That deal was with the Bucks. He is now with the Lakers. (fact, 2026-06-26; [06-26](https://youtu.be/CLsUc0Sevos?t=861), [06-22](https://youtu.be/HxQjagSTTAM?t=1290))
- Experts rate him only as a late dynasty rookie flier, around pick 50 in rookie drafts. He is worth watching, not drafting. (verdict, 2026-06-26; [06-23](https://youtu.be/-rgXhs5BHiw?t=1081), [06-26](https://youtu.be/CLsUc0Sevos?t=861))

**Durable**
- In college he had a very high block rate, a very high steal rate and a high free throw rate. He does not take threes. (fact, 2026-06-26; [06-23](https://youtu.be/-rgXhs5BHiw?t=1081), [06-22](https://youtu.be/HxQjagSTTAM?t=1290), [06-26](https://youtu.be/CLsUc0Sevos?t=861))
- His steal and block numbers translate well to the NBA. Experts compare him to Paul Reed. (verdict, 2026-06-26; [06-23](https://youtu.be/-rgXhs5BHiw?t=1081), [06-26](https://youtu.be/CLsUc0Sevos?t=861))
- He is a 6'11 big man, 23 years old at the 2026 draft. (fact, 2026-06-23; [06-23](https://youtu.be/-rgXhs5BHiw?t=1081))

**Tags**
- Current: `rookie` (Went undrafted in 2026.), `minutes competition` (Behind Kessler, Looney and Mamukelashvili at center.), `waiver watch` (Steals and blocks big. Watch if Kessler gets hurt.)
- Durable: none

**Note.** Castro is not a draft option in our league. Yahoo values him at 0 USD and ranks him 672, ESPN does not list him, and nobody in our league drafted him last season. His only fantasy interest is a stocks profile: high steal and block rates from a big, no threes, and a high free throw rate. Leave him on waivers and check in early in the season whether he is on the Lakers' active roster and whether a Kessler injury opens backup center minutes.
